_note: lb_rr scale-ramp: ONE DuckDB process -> nginx LB (8500, round-robin, proxy_next_upstream off) -> 2 vLLM backends (8000/8001). Scale is the only moving variable (calibration rule); concurrency frozen at C_total=64, which aligns with the 3-arm saturation point (gate c=32 per-endpoint = C_total 64; project K=32 per-endpoint = C_total 64). Uses the endpoint_count=1 lbrr_dev manifests (all rows -> LB; nginx splits across backends). The 3 gate arms are NOT included here -- they use the 2-endpoint squad_dev manifests and run in their own ramp; lb_rr is a separate manifest line so it cannot share a scale block. warmup_per_cell warms via bounded_http on the lbrr_dev manifest -- CAVEAT: a single-endpoint manifest only directly warms backend 0; backend 1 is warmed indirectly via the shared prefix cache, so lb_rr prefix-hit may read asymmetric across backends (report per-backend from X-Upstream-Addr / per-backend /metrics). PREREQUISITE: run the 256-row correctness gate FIRST (exactly-once, finish_reason=length=0, per-backend request-count + token-work skew) before trusting any lb_rr throughput number.
